land.derivation: The area's own Nominatim point (place/locality node for ワールドバザール, queried 2026-11-18; inside the Land bounding box). This is the fallback source of the app's parkRepresentativePoint() derivation; the original's Land dictionary holds no single stored constant for this point, so the value is recorded from that derivation route rather than from a dictionary row.

sea.area: メディテレーニアンハーバー
sea.derivation: The point the original's dictionary itself carries for the Mediterranean Harbor area (also the point on its entry / exit / parkwide-show rows). Used for parkwide shows and as the area representative point for Mediterranean Harbor.

notes: Coordinates outside a park's bounding box are never saved as fact (spec §10 park-range check, applied on both the dictionary and plan-item save paths).
A parkwide show's pin is always replaced by the park's entrance-area point on save, whatever coordinates were submitted (spec §10 parkwide rule).

Area representative points for other areas are derived the same way at runtime (the area's Nominatim point, else the centroid source used by areaPoint() in parts/server/src/actions.ts); they are not stored constants, so they are not listed here.
provenance: Area representative points and park bounding boxes as used by the original app (spec §10). The app does not hard-code representative-point coordinates: parkRepresentativePoint() derives the point at runtime from a facility-dictionary row in the park's entrance area, else from the area's own Nominatim point, park-range checked. The values below are the points in effect on 2026-11-18, recorded so a rebuilt copy starts from the same points instead of re-deriving them.
